title: Source: Meta plans to charge $300 for its forthcoming Muse Charm device and include a free 5G data plan from Verizon for up to 12 months (Jyoti Mann/The Information)
summary: Jyoti Mann / The Information: Source: Meta plans to charge $300 for its forthcoming Muse Charm device and include a free 5G data plan from Verizon for up to 12 months — Meta Platforms plans to charge $300 for its forthcoming Muse Charm device and offer user subsidies, according to a person familiar with the matter …
